SOURCE: Assassin's Creed (no particular installment)
GAME ENGINE: my-3D2dge, the handoff package in this directory (start with README.md)

Make a game: an adaptation of the source on this engine, a complete vertical slice that plays from a title screen to an
end. Put it in game/: game/index.html plays it, game/game.js holds it, game/test.mjs tests it without a browser. Check it
with node tools/check.mjs game/index.html before you finish.
